title: Settle a trade whose COMMIT goes unanswered by writing it again
message:
Settle a trade whose COMMIT goes unanswered by writing it again

A COMMIT that fails without the server's answer (a connection lost
while the reply was on its way) may have taken effect or not, but
trade_record() reported it as not recorded: a purchase restored the
hold and kept the gold while the database held the cargo and the
lower supply, and an undo kept the trade while the database had
undone it (MR !17 review, round 2).

trade_commit() now tells an unanswered COMMIT (a client error) from a
refused one. Both writes of a trade set absolute values, so
trade_record() writes the trade again on a reconnected session; once
that commits, the trade or its undo stands whichever way the first
COMMIT went. vessel_db_save_cargo() stops at its first failed write:
after a lost connection the next write would reconnect and commit on
its own, outside the transaction.

title: Check waypoint and route ownership in the vessel rules gate
message:
Check waypoint and route ownership in the vessel rules gate

Kohdee, staff, sets a waypoint and creates a route; Vesselmate, a
mortal captain, is refused deleting either or adding to the route,
then adds Kohdee's waypoint to a route of their own and deletes a
waypoint of their own; Kohdee deletes Vesselmate's route. The help
check reads DELROUTE's new rule, and cleanup deletes any waypoint or
route left under the names the session reported.

title: Let only a waypoint's or route's creator, or the staff, change it
message:
Let only a waypoint's or route's creator, or the staff, change it

Waypoints and routes recorded no creator, so any captain could delete
another's idle waypoint or route, and append a waypoint to any route.
A scheduled hull rebuilds her route from that shared cache at every
departure, so a rival could also change a public ferry's course, or
disable her schedule with a waypoint her route check cannot reach.

Schema Phase 24 adds creator_id (the player's ID; 0 for content and
older rows) to ship_waypoints and ship_routes, with rollback and
verifier SQL; boot adds it in vessel_ownership_ensure_schema().
setwaypoint and createroute record the player, and delwaypoint,
delroute and addtoroute allow only the creator or an immortal,
before S10's in-use refusals, which stay. Every route and waypoint
command now resolves a name to the caller's own row first, so a
rival's same-named row cannot lock a captain out of their own.

title: Plan S12: owned waypoints and routes (work item #11)
message:
Plan S12: owned waypoints and routes (work item #11)

Waypoints and routes record no creator, so any captain can delete
another's idle ones and append waypoints to any route, a public
ferry's included. S12 adds a creator column (schema Phase 24) and
lets only the creator or the staff change or delete a row.
